name: study-flow
description: Study Flow — aplicativo mobile de organização acadêmica e planejamento inteligente de estudos

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:deploy
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up && npm run db:deploy
scripts.dev:api: npm run db:up && npm run db:deploy && npm run -w @study-flow/api dev
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w @study-flow/shared typecheck && npm run -w @study-flow/api typecheck && npm run -w @study-flow/mobile typecheck
scripts.test:int: npm run db:up && npm run -w @study-flow/api test:int
